affected_component: Conferbot webhook and D1 event ledger
evidence: Webhook event row was initially inserted as processed before conversation/message/lead writes; injected conversation D1 failure returned 503, while retry was previously treated as duplicate and skipped downstream work.
remediation: Insert as received; return 503 on downstream persistence failure; retry received events idempotently; mark processed only after downstream durable work completes.
verification: check:conferbot injects a deterministic write failure, asserts received state and 503, retries, then asserts 200 and processed state; full checks pass.
residual_risk: No background reconciler/worker for permanently received events; operational DB monitoring and provider retry policy remain relevant. Integration is flag-off and LEAD_DB is unbound in checked config.

evidence: npm audit reports 13 moderate advisories; production-only audit is clean. Affected chain includes glob/minimatch and @opennextjs/aws via @opennextjs/cloudflare; reported fix path may require major adapter downgrade.
remediation: Assess compatible patched transitive versions with OpenNext maintainers/release notes; update a compatible lockfile in a separate tested dependency change. Do not force a major downgrade.
verification: npm audit --omit=dev: 0; full npm audit: 13 moderate, 0 high/critical; npm ls confirms paths; build and tests pass on current versions.
residual_risk: Build/CI dependency exploitation remains possible; no advisory currently reported in production dependency subset. Full details and compatibility caution in DEPENDENCY-AUDIT.md.

evidence: A listener on port 3100 previously could satisfy url readiness with reuseExistingServer enabled, regardless of whether it was the expected app/build.
remediation: Set reuseExistingServer false so Playwright launches/owns the configured process; collision must error rather than reuse.
verification: Controlled stale HTTP listener on 3100 caused Playwright to exit 1 with explicit port-in-use message; full suite passed against Playwright-owned server.
residual_risk: Fixed port collision makes tests fail until operator frees the port; it does not silently validate an unrelated instance.

evidence: rate-limit.ts performs separate KV get/put (not atomic); missing KV fails open for public contact/review/RUM buckets, and local Node without KV always fails open. Code comments document concurrency limitation.
remediation: Keep edge/WAF protections and operational monitoring; consider Cloudflare Rate Limiting/DO atomic counter only after traffic and product-impact analysis.
verification: Existing check:rate-limit validates per-IP windows, expiry, missing IP policy; config has REVIEWS KV binding.
residual_risk: Concurrent requests may exceed configured window; missing/misbound KV removes this layer for some public endpoints. Not relied on as authentication or payment authorization.
